$comment: Contract shape for Atlas SCHEMA.json — validation-first, machine-only. Not a full JSON Schema draft yet; normative field list from approved plan.

page_contract.$comment: Optional on live SCHEMA. Engine reads it; do not hardcode types in Python.

by_type.$comment: Each type may declare file + frontmatter required/recommended + sections; MD template carries a copy of rules

roles.experience: episodic — session / phase / challenge that happened
roles.lesson: semantic — do X / avoid Y (optional; distilled from experiences)
roles.work: task hub — scope, status, and relates_to cluster for a work_id
roles.document: durable content object — source material, page, file, note (not an episodic event)
roles.protostar: forming idea worth chasing later — linked to origin and work hub; not implement authority

notes: Types are recommendations, not a closed enum (OKF freedom).
memory is not a page type; Atlas is the memory substrate.

how_to_link: AUTHORITATIVE: frontmatter relates_to: [{path, kind}] — used by visualisers, tools, and compile-time graph consumers.
OPTIONAL: ## Related Markdown section may mirror relates_to for human reading of the body; agents should prefer frontmatter.
path values are relative to the Atlas root (forward slashes).
kind should be one of the recommended_kinds when possible.
atlas compile checks that relates_to paths resolve (and Markdown links if present).
On promote/compile, agent writes relates_to first; body Related is optional echo.

kind_meanings.follows: This item continues or comes after the target in a sequence (e.g. phase N follows phase N-1).
kind_meanings.records: This item (usually a decision) captures the outcome of the target experience/session.
kind_meanings.supersedes: This item replaces the target; prefer this over the target for current guidance.
kind_meanings.implements: This item carries out the target plan, decision, or work_id scope.
kind_meanings.derived_from: This item was distilled or extracted from the target.
kind_meanings.related: Generic association when no tighter role fits.
